bear.last: AMD: The bull's mean-reversion thesis attempts to catch a falling knife in a broken trend, with AMD trading below its 20-day SMA ($482.03), 50-day SMA ($545.90), and 200-day SMA ($434.00). The recent 4.06% single-day bounce is a classic dead-cat bounce executed on anemic volume, evidenced by a volume ratio of just 0.47. Despite a severe -25.41% plunge over the past 20 days, AMD remains priced for perfection at an 87.40 P/E and 14.66 P/S, leaving ample room for multiple compression. Corporate insiders clearly do not view this level as a bargain, having executed 62 open-market sells worth $102,480,674 against zero buys over the past 90 days. With daily ATR running at $45.21 (10.7% of price) and beta elevated at 2.67, risking down to the 20-day low of $370.40 exposes the account to massive downside drift without institutional accumulation.
